summary: The official West Bengal Banglarbhumi land-record portal and official government procedures were verified, and Balurghat BL&LRO/SD&LRO plus ADSR Balurghat were identified. Direct public portal routes timed out or returned 502, so no safe parcel ID, schema, CRS or geometry was obtained. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Bengali discovery queries and their actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-11743-balurghat.json.
requestOutcomes: Official portal landing/home/property routes, Government of West Bengal procedure material, official registration GIS and an official West Bengal office listing were attempted and recorded. No login, credentials, private token retention, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe field request or global TLS disable was used.
